solution-1.rationale: The solution implements robust procedural algorithms (second-order spring-damper conversational nodding driven by audio energy transients, stateful crossfading with decay envelopes, and unconditional unmuting safety guards) directly into the Three.js and state-management pipeline. The test coverage is extremely high and was upgraded to match modern design specs, resulting in a flawless 90/90 pass mark on the Playwright pressure test and confirming there are no regressions, hacks, or hardcoded values.
